headline: Weathered Expanse Ruined as Mooring Sees Fierce Fighting
war_summary: Since the morning filing the Weathered Expanse has fallen further into ruin to one Warden, two Colonial and six unheld strongpoints, with fourteen changes in two hours and eighty-one on the day centred on Wightwalk, Shattered Advance and Spirit Watch amid day losses of 8,375 Colonial and 11,475 Warden; Mooring County in contrast now stands wholly Warden at twelve holds after three changes in two hours and forty-two on the day about Gravekeeper's Holdfast, MacConmara Barrows and the Wind Hills with 7,246 Colonial and 6,299 Warden lost on the day. The Nevish Line holds six Warden to two Colonial, silent in the last two hours after three in six and twenty-four on the day about Blackcoat Way and Grief Mother, while Callahan's Passage remains wholly Warden and silent in the last two hours after three in six and thirteen on the day about the Crumbling Passage. Palantine Berm, Kuura Strand and Fisherman's Row, with nine, eighteen and fifteen changes on the day respectively, have recorded nothing in the last six hours.
